mainEntity.name: Is this OCR, or does it actually read the fields?

acceptedAnswer.text: It reads the fields. A digital PDF is reconstructed grid-line by grid-line and read cell by cell; an Excel WPS is parsed straight from the workbook. Process, materials, positions, ranges and every pass parameter land as typed, searchable values you can filter and export — not a flat scan you still have to read by eye.

mainEntity.name: What if my WPSs aren't in English?

acceptedAnswer.text: The parser reads a form's structure, not a fixed set of English words, and matches your labels from a language pack — so the language on the form doesn't change whether it's understood. English and Portuguese ship today; your language and in-house wording are added during onboarding by supplying the terms, with no code change.

mainEntity.name: How accurate is the extraction — and what if it misreads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anything the parser isn't sure of is flagged, not guessed silently, and every import is reviewed before it lands. You confirm reads against the original document in Preview and correct a misread in place, so what ends up on record is what a person checked — not the parser's raw output.

mainEntity.name: What happens when a form leaves heat input blank?

acceptedAnswer.text: The app computes it from the arc parameters (current × voltage × 60 ÷ travel speed × process efficiency, per EN 1011-1) and flags it for you to confirm against the PQR. It's never a silent number — you see the passes it came from and clear the flag once checked.

mainEntity.name: I have years of accumulated WPSs. Can I bring them all in at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — that first bulk load is exactly what batch import is for. Drop the whole stack in one pass; each file is sorted as it lands into a new WPS, a new revision of one you hold, or a correction, so revisions group correctly from the start instead of sprawling into duplicates.

mainEntity.name: Will it read our specific form, or just a generic one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard ISO 15609-style forms read out of the box; your exact layout is tuned in before you go live. You send a few real WPSs, we confirm the parser reads them and adjust the profile if needed, and only then do you commit — so import is proven on your own paperwork, handled in strict confidence.
